question: Which of the following union territories was a Portuguese colony until 1954?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadra and Nagar Haveli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dadra and Nagar Haveli** came under **Portuguese control** in **1783 and 1785**.
 
• Volunteers of **Goa parties** with the **co-operation** of the **local inhabitants** ended the **Portuguese rule** on **2ⁿd August 1954**.
 
• **Dadra and Nagar haveli** became a **union territory of India** under the **10th amendment** of the **Constitution of India in 1961**.
 
• **A bill was passed** in the **parliament** for the **Merger of Union territories** of **Daman And Diu** and **Dadra and Nagar haveli** in **2019** w.e.f from **26th January 2020**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41f1ab0ea2f2fdea368c128e3298ceb4b8828e0349134ba11d21c43261815026.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Puducherry**
 
 
 
• Capital: **Pondicherry**
 
• Lt. Governor: **Dr. Tamilisai Soundararajan**
 
• It is on the** Coromandesituatedl Coast of the Bay of Bengal**.
 
• **Puducherry airport** is the **first entirely solar-powered airport of the AAI in the country**.
 
• Became a **Union Territory of India in 1962** under the 14th Amendment of the Indian Constitution.
 
 
 
 

 **Lakshadweep**
 
 
 
• Capital:** Kavaratti**
 
• Administrator: **Praful Patel**
 
• **Smallest** Union Territory of India.
 
• It is an **archipelago of 36 Islands** in the **Arabian Sea** located** 280 to 400 km** **West of the Coast of Kerala**.
 
• It is the **first Union Territory** to become **100% Organic**.
 
 
 
 

 **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**
 
 
 
• Capital: **Port Blair**
 
• Lt. Governor: **Admiral D K Joshi**
 
• Situated in the **Indian Ocean, between the Bay of Bengal and the Andaman Sea**.
 
• Has a total of **836** **Islands/Islets/Rocky Outcrops** with **38 inhabited Islands**.
